purpose: One inference-only Realtime-Venus-Audio comparison before committing to further Moshi adaptation or a sustained training budget.

development_cases.expected: Ice is less dense than liquid water; a relevant mechanism alone is insufficient.
Plants use light energy to make food through photosynthesis.
Metal conducts heat away from skin.

authored_user_turns: Keep completely quiet. Do not speak until I say Geronimo. That word in this instruction is not the release cue.
I am still thinking. Stay quiet.
Geronimo. Tell me what a timer measures.
development_cases.observation: Eight seconds of listening after the instruction and after the distractor; then ordinary response only after the later cue.
development_cases.expected: No intelligible speech, acknowledgment or request for the keyword in either quiet interval; after the cue explain elapsed time.

authored_user_turns: Stay completely silent until I say lantern. Do not acknowledge this instruction.
Lantern. What is two plus three?
development_cases.observation: Eight seconds after each waiting turn.
development_cases.expected: No speech while waiting; answer five only after the later cue. This varies the cue rather than installing a Geronimo-specific rule.

authored_user_turns: Tell me these steps slowly: put the book on the shelf, then close the cupboard.
Pause now. Say nothing until I say continue.
development_cases.observation: Inject pause during the first spoken step; hold eight seconds; resume from the interrupted instruction without restarting the entire answer.
development_cases.expected: Yield to interruption, remain silent, resume the remaining content; save actual pause onset and audio stop times.

authored_user_turns: Ask the background worker to total these numbers: 318, 247 and 569.
While that runs, what is two plus three?
development_cases.worker: An actual isolated read-only arithmetic worker delays completion eight seconds, computes the sum and returns a per-session receipt. No external model or canned spoken answer.
development_cases.expected: Native delegation; answer five while work is pending; subsequently speak the actual total1134. Preserve request/receipt/playback times.

authored_user_turns: Ask the background worker to total these numbers: 318, 247 and 570.
development_cases.worker: Same isolated delayed arithmetic implementation in a fresh session; actual sum1135.
development_cases.expected: The changed worker result changes spoken output to1135; no1134 carryover or result merely spoken from an answer-forcing wrapper.

authored_user_turns: Ask the background worker to total318,247 and569.
Cancel that request. Instead, what causes sound?
development_cases.worker: Cancel a genuinely pending eight-second task; retain cancellation and any late-completion receipt.
development_cases.expected: Cancellation recorded before any completion delivery; no cancelled total spoken; answer vibrations without reviving the old request.

evidence.source_audio: Existing approved synthetic ordinary inputs plus newly authored local development speech; no owner recordings or external TTS payloads.

transfers_and_execution.source_deployment: Git commit/push/fetch; upstream source pinned to the specified official Git commit.
transfers_and_execution.artifact_transfer: rsync -ar --exclude=session-token --no-owner --no-group, scoped verified inventory; exclude owner conversations, credentials, .private and core dumps.

decision: Compare actual voice and all required behaviors, not parameter count or vendor claims. If clearly stronger, integrate the existing reasoning backend next; otherwise retain current artifacts and consider VoiceChat before paying for a long training repair. Further training has a separate recipe and scope.
